verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair question for an online company-filing portal, since it could offer scheduled or bulk filing. However, the evidence shows only manual, interactive features: online filing, dashboards, progress tracking and prepaid-account payment for high-volume mandataires. Nothing documents user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background. The keyless API probe concerns a separate state company-data service, not the Guichet unique.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
